'''Banks''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and a companion of [[Erisson Flask]]. Banks was wounded in a [[Lightfight|gunfight]] on [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]].<ref name="RC" />
